creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Dependencies between cards live in prose today, which nothing can query.

Design: `docs/design/work-across-boards.md`, sections "Links", "Collisions with existing custom fields", "Parents", "Commands" and "Lookup results". Covers the card/4 schema and its migration (renaming a colliding custom field to `x_blocked_by` or `x_related`, rewriting alias parents to IDs), one link service behind `kan link`, `kan unlink` and `kan add --blocked-by`, refusing cycles and links to an ancestor, the lookup result every stored ref resolves to, and `kan show` listing both directions.

After a_2naKFngG2.
title: Add blocked_by and related links to cards (card/4)
